custom_logic_notes: ColorMETRO is a custom indicator combining RSI with two step-moving averages (fast step=5, slow step=15). The EA reads two buffers: MPlus (buffer 0) and MMinus (buffer 1). Entry signal requires crossover on the completed bar [1] AND the previous bar [0] must not already be in the signal state (MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0] for buy, MPlus[0]>=MMinus[0] for sell), preventing duplicate entries on the same crossover. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with global variable management. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from bar index 1 (last completed bar). Entry permissions are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen booleans; exit permissions by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose.
python_conversion_notes: Primary challenge: ColorMETRO indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It is an RSI-based step-moving-average indicator with two smoothing speeds. Without the ColorMETRO source code, the exact algorithm is unknown. If ColorMETRO source can be located (likely in MQL5/Indicators/), its logic must be translated to Python (pandas/numpy). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides standard position open/close helpers with global variable tracking - these can be replaced with simple backtest position management. The crossover logic with lookback check (bar[1] crosses, bar[0] was opposite) is straightforward to implement. StopLoss=1000 points and TakeProfit=2000 points must be converted to price distances (1000*point for 5-digit broker = 100 pips SL, 200 pips TP). Position sizing: negative MM means fixed lot=0.1.
